source.rule: Items or subsystems present in a system but omitted from the current mission RBD are considered in series with that RBD. A failing member of an active parallel RBD remains noncritical while its NBREQ condition is met.

configuration.added_position: POS-D in the same system, physical QTYPM1, FM-POS-D FRT1000000 per million OPHOURS, BASE-01 half-hour direct CM
configuration.omitted_arm: POS-D present in physical MaterielStructure and MaterielOperationalModes but not in RBDParallelStructure
configuration.included_arm: otherwise identical, POS-D added as fourth active RBD link and NBOP4
configuration.other_failure_modes: accepted parent POS-A 300000 and POS-B 600000 per million OPHOURS; POS-C no configured failure mode

exact_delta: Both arms add POS-D, its LRU structure, direct failure mode, CM route and operational mode, plus description. Only the included arm adds POS-D to RBDParallelStructure and sets NBOP3→4 with matching description. Between arms only ProblemDescription, RBDParallel and RBDParallelStructure differ. Parent mission, existing positions, failure modes, repairs, seed and report controls remain fixed.
pre_run_hypotheses: Native import/export preserves every populated authored row and the converter accepts both arms without errors or unreviewed warnings.

If POS-D fails during the mission in both matched arms, omitted POS-D should be critical and abort its mission despite the healthy parallel remainder; included POS-D should be noncritical while at least one of the four active links is functional. Record actual failure identities/times and do not assume matched random samples.
Event-level failure, mission, repair and physical readiness transitions should reconcile with 72-bin aggregate reports. A single seed does not establish a general reliability difference.
native_acceptance: Two unique guarded session-0 SSH runs, host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity checks, Prelife Log registry restoration and frozen source/raw SHA-256 seals.
Both arms: exact populated-table roundtrip, zero converter errors/notes, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report.
Matched POS-D failure identity and time, opposite criticality and mission outcome attributable to source-bound RBD inclusion; A/B event differences, if any, explicitly accounted for.
Read-only independent replay of source, raw seals, events and report apart from author validation.
diagnostic_gate: If either converter rejects the model, POS-D does not fail in both arms, POS-D draws diverge, or omission fails to produce the expected critical-versus-noncritical distinction, preserve the runs as diagnostic and revise with a new candidate version/run IDs. Do not infer series semantics from source alone.
limits: One omitted fourth position under one mission mode, one failure rate, one seed and one replication; no general default-series truth table.
No arbitrary omitted item level, multiple mission modes, GUI RBD visual or cross-engine claim.
